Data Center Resource Get Datacenters
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/datacenters

Retrieves the list of Zscaler data centers (DCs) that can be excluded from service to your organization

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
datacenter
string

Zscaler data center name.

]
